candidates.source_name: Portal javnih naročil (enarocanje.si) — Uradni list RS
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenia's statutory national publication portal for all contract notices (obvestila o naročilu), corrections, award notices and contract amendments, operated by Javno podjetje Uradni list RS d.o.o. All Slovenian public buyers — including Banka Slovenije, ministries, UJP, municipalities and state-owned companies — must publish here, so compliance-driven banking/payment/supervisory-IT projects surface with scope, estimated value and hard submission deadlines months before any public announcement. Bank of Slovenia's own pages point to this portal as the place its procurement documentation is published.
candidates.access_status: public, no registration needed for browsing notices
candidates.legal_status: official government/state-publisher publication; ZJN-3 mandated publication
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled scrape of the notice search (pregled objav) filtered by CPV codes for financial/banking services (66xxxxxx) and IT/software (72xxxxxx), plus keyword filters; capture notice ID, buyer, CPV, value, deadline, and linked documentation.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + snowball from Banka Slovenije procurement statement
queries_used: e-JN portal javnega naročanja plačilne storitve banka javno naročilo
enarocanje.si portal javnih naročil Uradni list obvestila o naročilu iskalnik
Banka Slovenije javna naročila objave razpisi bsi.si

candidates.why_relevant: The state e-procurement transaction system (Ministrstvo za javno upravo / Direktorat za javno naročanje) where tender documentation is issued and bids are submitted electronically. Its 'Aktualna javna naročila' listing exposes live procedures with deadlines; it is the operational counterpart to the enarocanje.si notice layer and often holds the actual specification documents for supervisory-reporting and AML tooling.
candidates.access_status: public listing; bidding requires free registration
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the aktualna_javna_narocila listing page on a schedule; cross-reference notice IDs with enarocanje.si and the OPSI dataset mirror of the same list.
queries_used: e-JN portal javnega naročanja plačilne storitve banka javno naročilo
javno naročilo programska oprema poročanje Banka Slovenije AML

candidates.source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU OJ Supplement)
candidates.why_relevant: All Slovenian above-threshold contracts (services threshold in the ~EUR 140k range for central authorities) must be published in TED in parallel with the national portal. TED gives structured, multilingual, CPV/NUTS-filterable coverage of SI banking-services and supervisory-IT tenders, plus award notices revealing incumbent vendors and contract values. Already surfaced a Slovenian banking-services procurement (Aerodrom Ljubljana/Brnik).
candidates.legal_status: official EU publication (Publications Office); open reuse
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Expert-query filter NUTS=SI* AND CPV in {66100000 banking, 66110000, 66172000 payment transaction processing, 72xxxxxx IT services, 48xxxxxx software}; harvest via the TED Search API rather than HTML.
queries_used: TED tenders europa Slovenia payment services bank tender notice
local_language_terms_used: javno naročilo (SI notices carry sl-language titles on TED)

candidates.source_name: TED Search API / TED Open Data (docs.ted.europa.eu)
candidates.why_relevant: Authentication-free machine interface to TED notices (expert queries, bulk XML download, SPARQL endpoint, eForms SDK). This is the sustainable collection mechanism for the whole EU-threshold layer of the Slovenian public-buyer route — enabling continuous monitoring of SI banking/payments/supervisory-IT tenders with deadlines and award data.
candidates.access_status: open, no authentication for the Search API (paging limits: ~250/page, ~15k per query)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily incremental pull via Search API with a saved expert query; store raw eForms XML for provenance.
queries_used: TED europa API open data notices search developer documentation eForms

candidates.source_name: OPSI — Odprti podatki Slovenije: 'Aktualna javna naročila v informacijskem sistemu e-JN' dataset
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable open-data mirror of the live e-JN tender list published by the Ministry of Public Administration — the cleanest structured feed for current Slovenian procurements without scraping JSF pages.
candidates.legal_status: official open data, licensed for reuse
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch the dataset resource file on a schedule via the CKAN-style API; diff against previous snapshot to detect new notices.
queries_used: podatki.gov.si OPSI javna naročila statistika ministrstvo za javno upravo letno poročilo

candidates.source_name: OPSI — Zbirka letnih statističnih poročil o oddanih javnih naročilih
candidates.why_relevant: Annual statutory statistics on awarded public contracts (prepared under ZJN-3 by the Ministry and approved by Government). Gives multi-year baselines for how much the Slovenian public sector spends on financial/banking services and IT, useful for sizing the addressable public-buyer segment and spotting trend breaks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual pull of the published PDF/CSV releases; also mirror the Directorate's own reports page.
queries_used: podatki.gov.si OPSI javna naročila statistika ministrstvo za javno upravo letno poročilo

candidates.source_name: Direktorat za javno naročanje (MJU) — poročila, analize, usmeritve
candidates.why_relevant: The policy owner of the Slovenian procurement system. Its guidance, circulars and analyses tell you how buyers are being told to structure financial-services and IT tenders (e.g. joint/central procurement, framework agreements), which shapes the shape and timing of banking/payments tenders. Also an authoritative pointer to all system components (e-JN, portal, ESPD, e-Dosje).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl of the reports/analyses and guidance sections; snapshot changed documents.
queries_used: e-JN portal javnega naročanja plačilne storitve banka javno naročilo

candidates.why_relevant: Independent review body deciding bid-protest disputes (zahtevek za revizijo). Its published decisions expose tender requirements, competitor arguments, disqualification grounds and pricing disputes in banking-services and IT procurements in far more detail than the notice itself — and reveal which awards are delayed, which shifts real delivery dates.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword-scoped search crawl ('bančne storitve', 'plačilne storitve', 'programska oprema', 'poročanje') with periodic re-run; store decision IDs and dates.
queries_used: Državna revizijska komisija DKOM odločitve javna naročila bančne storitve

candidates.why_relevant: Anti-Corruption Commission application (successor to Supervizor, rebuilt 2023-2025) exposing actual payment flows from public bodies and state/municipally owned companies to suppliers under Arts. 75a/75b ZIntPK. Lets you verify who actually gets paid for banking, payment-processing and compliance-software work after award, including contracts below publication thresholds — i.e. the vendor landscape a tender notice alone will not show.
candidates.access_status: public web app; underlying evidence also catalogued on OPSI
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query by payer (e.g. Banka Slovenije, UJP, ministries) and by known vendor names; prefer the OPSI dataset/API over UI scraping where available.
queries_used: ERAR Supervizor KPK javna poraba podatki javna naročila Slovenija

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije — Katalog informacij javnega značaja
candidates.why_relevant: The central bank's statutory public-information catalogue is the authoritative pointer to how and where it publishes its own procurement (it directs to enarocanje.si) plus its contracts, internal acts and FOI contact. Essential to confirm the buyer profile of the single most important public buyer of supervisory/reporting IT in the cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly snapshot; use it to derive the exact buyer identifier used on enarocanje.si/TED for Banka Slovenije notices.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije javna naročila objave razpisi bsi.si

candidates.why_relevant: Not a procurement source, but the demand-generator: changes to reporting frameworks (MFI reporting, payment-system operator reporting, AML/ZPPDFT-2 data) with their compliance deadlines are what trigger both bank-side and public-buyer IT procurements. Pairing this calendar with the tender feeds is what turns a notice into an early signal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Change-detection on the reporting sub-pages and their attachment lists; extract effective dates and first-reporting deadlines.
queries_used: javno naročilo programska oprema poročanje Banka Slovenije AML
local_language_terms_used: preprečevanje pranja denarja in financiranja terorizma

candidates.source_name: UJP — Uprava RS za javna plačila: JN Plačila / e-Plačila
candidates.why_relevant: UJP is the state payments administration and itself a public buyer and operator of payment rails for the whole budget-user population. The JN Plačila portal (transaction reporting + contract publication for procurement payments) and UJP e-Plačila (card, mobile — VALÚ Moneta, mBills — and NLB Klik acceptance) define the public-sector payments stack; changes and related tenders are direct commercial signals for payment vendors.
candidates.access_status: public documentation; operational portal requires credentials
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the UJP service pages and PDF manuals for version changes; cross-check UJP as a 'naročnik' on enarocanje.si/TED.
queries_used: e-JN portal javnega naročanja plačilne storitve banka javno naročilo

candidates.source_name: Mestna občina Ljubljana — Služba za javna naročila (buyer-side publication)
candidates.why_relevant: Representative large municipal buyer profile. Municipalities procure banking services (account operation, cash handling, POS acceptance, loans) and are a recurring, below-EU-threshold segment invisible on TED. Ljubljana is the template for building a buyer-profile watchlist across the largest Slovenian municipalities and public utilities.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Add to a buyer-profile crawl list (Ljubljana, Maribor, Celje, Kranj, Koper, plus public utilities and health institutions); RSS/HTML diff.
queries_used: "javno naročilo" "bančne storitve" občina razpis Slovenija 2025

candidates.why_relevant: The governing procurement statute, including the rule that banking and other financial services are valued on fees, commissions and interest — which determines whether a banking-services contract crosses the EU threshold and therefore whether it appears on TED at all. Needed to interpret thresholds, exemptions and publication duties correctly.
candidates.legal_status: official legal information system of the Republic of Slovenia
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Version-watch the consolidated text; alert on amendments affecting thresholds or financial-services scope.
queries_used: "javno naročilo" "bančne storitve" občina razpis Slovenija 2025

candidates.source_name: PISRS — Zakon o plačilnih in javnofinančnih storitvah (ZPJS)
candidates.why_relevant: Defines how budget users (proračunski uporabniki) obtain payment and public-finance services — i.e. the legal frame that decides whether a public body buys payment services on the market via tender or receives them from UJP/Banka Slovenije. Directly determines the size of the addressable public-sector payments tender market.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Version-watch consolidated text and its implementing regulations.
queries_used: "javno naročilo" "bančne storitve" občina razpis Slovenija 2025

candidates.why_relevant: Third-party aggregator of Slovenian and regional tender notices with its own categorisation and alerting. Useful as a redundancy/cross-check layer against enarocanje.si and to catch notices whose CPV coding is wrong, but not authoritative and likely subscription-gated for detail.
candidates.access_status: partly public, likely paywalled/registration for full records
candidates.legal_status: private commercial service — check ToS before automated collection
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/low-frequency cross-check only; do not scrape without reviewing terms of service.
queries_used: "javno naročilo" "bančne storitve" občina razpis Slovenija 2025

candidates.why_relevant: Private e-procurement/e-sourcing platform used by Slovenian buyers alongside the state system. Some public and state-owned buyers run their sourcing here, so its public notice listing can surface procedures (and vendor references) not obvious on the state portal; also a competitor/partner signal in the procurement-tech layer.
candidates.access_status: public landing; procedures likely require registration
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic manual review of public listings/references; treat as supplementary.
queries_used: javno naročilo programska oprema poročanje Banka Slovenije AML

candidates.source_name: e-Justice / gov.si — 'Na katerih spletiščih se objavijo uradna obvestila?' (SI official publication map)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative EU/national map of which Slovenian websites carry which mandatory official announcements, including procurement. Useful to guarantee the source inventory for this cell has no legally-required publication channel missing (Uradni list RS, portal javnih naročil, AJPES, etc.).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off harvest for inventory completeness; re-check annually.
queries_used: enarocanje.si portal javnih naročil Uradni list obvestila o naročilu iskalnik

candidates.source_name: EU Public Procurement portal (op.europa.eu) — procurement detail records
candidates.why_relevant: Publications Office front-end presenting individual procurement records (including Slovenian banking-services procurements) in a stable, citable form; complements TED notices with consolidated per-procedure views useful for evidencing award histories.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as a citation/enrichment layer for records harvested via the TED API.
queries_used: TED tenders europa Slovenia payment services bank tender notice

negative_findings.description: Targeted Slovenian-language searches for a Banka Slovenije public tender specifically for AML or supervisory-reporting software ('javno naročilo programska oprema poročanje Banka Slovenije AML') returned only Banka Slovenije's reporting-requirement and AML policy pages, no procurement notice.
negative_findings.result_summary: No specific central-bank AML/reporting-software tender was located via general web search; such notices are likely discoverable only inside the enarocanje.si / e-JN search interfaces, which are not well indexed by general search engines.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that this cell cannot be worked from general web search alone — collection must go through the portal search forms and the TED API directly.

negative_findings.description: Individual enarocanje.si notice pages surface in search only as opaque parameterised URLs (e.g. /Obrazci/?id_obrazec=382041) with no readable title, and the archive path /arhiv/<id>/ likewise.
negative_findings.result_summary: Notice-level content on the national portal is effectively invisible to keyword search engines; only the ID is exposed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must enumerate via the portal's own search/pagination or via an ID-sweep, not via external search; also means dedupe keys should be notice IDs.

negative_findings.description: No pages were fetched in this pass; all sources are recorded from search-result evidence only.
negative_findings.result_summary: Liveness, robots.txt posture, rate limits and any bot defences (notably on enarocanje.si, ejn.gov.si JSF pages, dkom.si and ERAR) are untested.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass must establish reachability and scraping constraints before any collector is built; a 403 on these should be treated as bot-defence, not death.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian-language equivalent term was found in this pass for the 'instant payments upgrade' procurement concept (e.g. a standard phrase such as 'takojšnja plačila' / 'plačila v realnem času') appearing in tender titles.
negative_findings.result_summary: Instant-payments-specific local tender vocabulary remains unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Keyword filters for the SEPA Instant / IPR-driven procurement wave may miss Slovenian notices until the local phrase actually used by buyers is established from real notice titles.

coverage_gaps.description: State-owned and state-controlled financial actors as buyers (SID banka, SDH-held banks, Zavarovalnica Triglav group, DUTB successors, Poštna banka/Pošta Slovenije) were not individually mapped as contracting authorities or utilities-sector buyers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a buyer registry of SI state-owned/controlled financial and utility entities, resolve each to its enarocanje.si buyer identifier and TED organisation ID, and subscribe per buyer.

coverage_gaps.description: No verified CPV code list was assembled for this cell (banking 661xxxxx, payment transaction processing, financial IT 72/48 families) against actual Slovenian notice usage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract CPV frequency distribution from historical SI notices via the TED API, then pin a validated CPV filter set rather than guessing codes.

coverage_gaps.description: Below-EU-threshold and 'naročila male vrednosti' (small-value) procurements — where most municipal banking-services and niche compliance-software contracts sit — are covered only by the national portal and ERAR, not by TED.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Make enarocanje.si the primary feed (not TED) and add ERAR payment-flow queries as the post-award net for contracts never published at all.

coverage_gaps.description: Pre-notice planning signals — 'predhodno informativno obvestilo' (prior information notices), načrt javnih naročil (annual procurement plans published by buyers), and budget documents (proračun, finančni načrt Banke Slovenije) — were not collected.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add PIN-type notices and buyers' annual procurement plans to the collection scope; these give 6-12 months more lead time than a contract notice.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of Slovenian notices is thin outside TED; national-portal content is Slovenian-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat sl as the primary collection language with machine translation at the analysis layer; never rely on English keyword filters against enarocanje.si.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-central-bank supervisory and infrastructure buyers relevant to banking/payments — ATVP (securities), AZN (insurance), Urad RS za preprečevanje pranja denarja (FIU), AJPES, FURS — were not confirmed as tracked contracting authorities.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add these authorities to the buyer watchlist; the FIU in particular drives AML reporting-system procurement.

brief: Slovenia's public-buyer route is unusually clean: a single statutory notice portal (enarocanje.si, run by Uradni list RS) carries every contract notice, the state e-procurement system e-JN (ejn.gov.si, MJU) carries the documentation and bidding, and above-threshold procedures duplicate to TED where a free, unauthenticated Search API makes systematic monitoring practical. The high-value signal for banking and payments is the pairing of these tender feeds with Banka Slovenije's reporting/AML pages — regulatory reporting deadlines are what generate the compliance-driven IT procurements, and the notice usually lands months ahead of any market announcement. Below-EU-threshold work (municipal banking services, small compliance tools) never reaches TED, so enarocanje.si must be primary and KPK's ERAR used as the post-award net for what was never tendered publicly; DKOM decisions add depth and reveal award delays. Main open work is mechanical rather than exploratory: resolve buyer identifiers for the central bank, FIU, ATVP and state-owned financial entities, pin a validated CPV filter set from historical SI notices, and extend collection upstream to prior information notices and buyers' annual procurement plans.
